title: Spikers' Turf: Criss Cross overcomes Alpha Insurance, extends win streak to 3
summary: Defending champion Criss Cross maintained its perfect start in the 2026 Spikers' Turf Invitational Conference after taking down Alpha Insurance in four sets, Sunday night at the Filoil EcoOil Centre.
